observation.visible_scene: A still landscape of a calm lake: a snow-capped mountain range spans the horizon under a clear blue sky, with a golden-brown grassy hill sloping down on the left and a small cluster of buildings and trees on the right shore. The mountains and hills are mirrored in the dark blue water below, and a thin bare branch/reed sits in the lower-left foreground.
visible_changes: The reflection of the snow-capped mountains in the water shows continuous subtle wavering and distortion across the frames, indicating small ripples on the lake surface already in progress at the start of the excerpt.
The actual mountains, hill, sky, and right-shore buildings remain fixed in the same image positions throughout, so the scene composition and camera framing are essentially static.
The foreground reed/branch in the lower-left does not move.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the water ripples intensify, calm, or persist after this segment is not shown.
The cause of the surface ripples (e.g., wind) is not directly visible.
Any motion before t=0 or after t=2.669s is outside the excerpt.
uncertain_details: Any very slight camera drift cannot be fully ruled out, but background landmarks stay at constant pixel positions, so the camera is treated as stationary.
The exact pattern of the reflection's distortion changes frame-to-frame in a way consistent with gentle water motion rather than any object moving.
